description: Frames from a post's video, returned as images you can look at yourself rather than an analysis of them. They are chosen by scene change rather than by the clock: the video is decoded through and a frame kept whenever the picture actually changed, so every distinct shot is represented, including a short cutaway inside a long take. The result says how many shots were found, how many frames came back and whether the cap left any out, so you never have to guess what you have seen. A carousel or slideshow returns its own images unchanged. Pair it with get_post_transcript to have both what is shown and what is said, and judge them yourself. Each frame costs you roughly 1,200 tokens of context. Consumes 2 nooticr credits. Use when you need only the frames; analyze_post returns them together with the transcript, for 3 credits.

count.description: The most frames to return (max 24). Omit it and scene mode returns one frame per shot.

mode.description: auto (default) decides per video; scene returns one frame per distinct shot; even keeps the old fixed-interval sampling, which is what you want when two posts must be compared at matching positions.

name: get_post_frames

coverageNote.description: The above as one sentence, including that a still cannot show motion within a shot.

frames.description: Base64 frames; also delivered as image content blocks.

cached.description: true when the answer was served from the server's cache, at no cost.

charged.description: false when the call was refused before anything was debited.

commentSample.description: The replies themselves, when they were read. Someone answering "same here, this is exactly my problem" under another person's thread is a better find than the thread — the permalink to quote is still this post's.

commentsRead.description: How many replies were read under this post. 0 means the thread would not open — not that nobody replied. Absent when nothing tried.

externalUrl.description: Permalink — the URL to feed back into another tool.

scanComplete.description: False when a bound stopped the read before the video ended.

scenesDetected.description: Distinct shots found. Null when no scan ran, which is not the same as zero.

selection.description: 'scene' (one frame per distinct shot), 'even' (fixed interval) or 'images' (a carousel's own pictures).

truncated.description: True when shots were found that are not in `frames`.

title: Get Post Frames
